user_authorization: Explore boldly in backtests; no change to trading activation. Agent owns parameter selection and must preserve all failures.

scope.price_inputs: same cached SIP raw daily dataset, no new outcome window claimed

universe: Exclude current official ETF=Y or test_issue=Y classifications before this experiment. Unknown classifications retained and flagged. Current directories remain non-point-in-time.

signals.momentum20: 20-session split-adjusted close return>=10%; close>=prior20 mean adjusted closes
signals.trend_pullback: 20-session return>=10%; -8%<=today return<=-2%; close>=prior20 mean adjusted closes
signals.acceleration3: 3-session adjusted close return>=10%; today close>previous adjusted high; relative_volume>=1.5

strength.trend_pullback: negative of today return (larger qualifying pullback first)

execution: Signals use completed prior session only; choose first ranked signal affordable at prior close using the portfolio cash budget. If actual next open becomes unaffordable, skip without choosing runner-up. Integer shares sized using opening print is an idealized market-order sizing assumption, not verified live implementability.
portfolio: One position max. No re-entry on an exit day. At most one entry per session. Fixed holding period counts entry session as day1, exits closing print of Nth session. No intrabar stops/targets. No borrowing or capital injections.
marking: Daily liquidation-equivalent equity=cash+unpaid dividend receivables+shares*close*(1-exit_cost). Planned exits at close include cost; final open positions are marked/censored, not invented liquidations.
corporate_actions: Apply unambiguous ticker splits on ex-date, adjust historical signal-window prices/volumes for splits effective by decision date; adjust held shares before trading. Noninteger post-split shares or unresolved symbol changes halt affected paths as unverified instead of inventing cash-in-lieu. Credit USD cash-dividend receivable on ex-date for prior-close holdings, move to cash on payable date; invalid/missing dates/currency flags must be preserved. Use actual supplied actions, never derive trade profit from raw split jumps.
missing: Missing selected entry/held mark/exit stops path with incomplete status; do not drop missing losing positions. Ambiguous actions on held symbols stop path. Large absolute adjusted close change>25% flags path/model risk but does not silently remove winner or loser.
analysis: All192paths and failures, continuous monthly marks, quarters, all closed trades and censored holdings
Compare paired costs, holding horizons, ranking and allocation; do not promote maximum in-sample outcome
All data already seen/exploratory. Quarter or month slices cannot be called unseen validation.
funding: Each separate hypothetical path starts500 once. No restart in this matrix; no aggregate profit from summing separate hypothetical accounts. Historical40% stop and separate main-account10% stop do not apply.
limitations: Current universe, unknown instrument classes and corporate-action completeness are not certified point-in-time.
No option returns because executable historical bid/ask missing.
Daily open/close cost model does not verify quote liquidity, order fills, fees, PDT or settlement.
Multiple192candidate search exaggerates apparent best performance; preserve all candidates.
